# 1 Enoch Chapter 68 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**1** And after this my grandfather Enoch gave me the sum of the teaching of all the secrets in the book of the Parables which had been given to him, and he put them together for me in the words of the book of the Parables.

**2** And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: The power of the spirit transports and makes me tremble because of the severity of the judgment of the secrets — the judgment of the angels. Who can endure the severe judgment which has been executed, and before which they melt away?

**3** And Michael answered again, and said to Raphael: Who is he whose heart is not softened concerning it, and whose reins are not troubled by this word of the judgment that has gone forth upon them — because of those who have thus led them out?

**4** And it came to pass when he stood before the Lord of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: I will not take their part under the eye of the Lord; for the Lord of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were the Lord.

**5** Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion assigned to him, but alone they receive their judgment for ever and ever.

---

*LOGOS notes: Formal equivalence rendering. Ch. 68 contains the most intimate angelic dialogue in the Parables — Michael and Raphael discussing the severity of the judgment and Michael explicitly refusing to intercede for the fallen angels. V. 4b ('they do as if they were the Lord') is the ultimate charge: the fallen angels committed the sin of assuming divine prerogatives.*
